text:
Priya: Hey team — blocking merge on PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/12899. Buildkite failed on the windows e2e shard with a Postgres connection timeout (unit-e2e-shard-7). Can someone take a quick look? :pleading_face:
Alex: looking now. Do we have the failed step log?
Priya: pasted the relevant tail below from the job: ```ERROR: could not obtain a connection from the pool: timeout after 30s
  at tests/e2e/test_workflows.py::test_streaming_session
  shard: unit-e2e-shard-7```
Jamal: hmm that's the flaky DB pool + CI infra interop we've seen. Two options: retry the shard or run the isolated test locally in WSL. If retry passes we can merge.
Priya: I tried a rebuild but Buildkite queued behind other jobs, so asking for help to trigger a manual rerun if someone has permissions. Also I reproduced locally with `TEST_SHARD=7 pytest tests/e2e/test_workflows.py::test_streaming_session -k streaming` and hit the same timeout once.
Alex: can you paste the exact rerun command for the job id? I'll kick it.
Priya: job id is 45678 on buildkite. Command we use on infra VM: ```bk buildkite-agent build 45678 --requeue --env TEST_SHARD=7```
CI Bot: Buildkite: requeue for job 45678 requested by Alex at 2024-11-02T15:22:03Z. Status: queued.
Maria: if it flakes locally maybe increase DB pool or add a short retry in test (not ideal). For this PR the change is small (connection pooling tweak) — if rerun passes can we get an approval and merge? The release is waiting. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Jamal: I'll watch the rerun. If it passes, I can give a quick code + test review. If it fails again, let's mark the test xfail and follow up with a proper fix.
Alex: rerun completed — unit-e2e-shard-7 passed this time :tada: CI Bot shows all shards green.
CI Bot: Buildkite: job 45678 completed successfully. All checks passed.
Priya: awesome, thanks all. @Jamal please post your approve when you're done. Also added a brief note in the PR about the transient DB timeout.
Jamal: reviewed, left one tiny nits comment and approved. :shipit:
Priya: merging now. Thanks everyone!
